reference.title: Licensing and the GOV.UK brand
reference.shortdesc: What you may reuse freely, and the assets reserved for official GOV.UK services.

section.title: The plugin
section.p: The plugin is published under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The vendored govuk-frontend assets keep their own MIT licence. Neither licence grants any right to the GOV.UK brand.

section.title: Reserved assets
section.p: Two things are reserved for official GOV.UK services and are deliberately not shipped by this plugin:

dlentry.dd: Permitted only on services on the gov.uk domain, delivered by or for a government department. The neutral and iStandUK themes carry no crown.
Licensed for official use only. The plugin aliases it to a system font stack, so no restricted font file is ever downloaded.

section.note: Enabling govuk.branding=official asserts that your service is entitled to the GOV.UK brand. Only turn it on for a genuine GOV.UK service.
